name: frontend-perfection
description: Audit and polish frontend to verifiable perfection: real-Chrome Lighthouse >=13 runs via chrome-launcher + Node API (mobile+desktop, no Playwright internals, .default fallback, self-resolved deps — exits 0/1/2 with compact JSON report of failed audit ids), plus an offline Python-stdlib static audit (SEO meta layer, WCAG contrast by computed luminance, heading order, design tokens with zero raw hex outside the token block, fixed-header scroll-padding, breakpoints) and crop-safe OG-image generation (1200x630 with ~640px central safe zone, URL change instead of overwrite to bust social caches, forced reflow before screenshot). report.json is written per run; every fix binds to an audit id. Triggers: 'frontend audit', 'perfect the layout', 'lighthouse check', 'make it 100/100/100/100', 'audit the page', 'fix performance', 'contrast check', 'design tokens', 'og image', 'social share meta'.
author: best
